**THE AKRON DAILY BEACON**

**VOL. 1, ISSUE 1**

**JULY 3, 2014**

**AKRON, OHIO: A CITY VANISHES IN AN INSTANT**

...and then, there was nothing. No warning, no signs, no indication of what was to come. One moment, the city of Akron was bustling with life; the next, it was gone. The streets were empty, the buildings stood as skeletons, and the people... well, the people were nowhere to be found.

Eyewitnesses describe the scene as "apocalyptic" and "surreal" as the city's residents, families, and friends awoke to find themselves alone, with no memory of what had happened the night before. "I woke up to an empty house," said Jane Doe, a local resident. "I had no idea what had happened to my family. I just knew I was alone."

As the day wore on, the reality of the situation began to sink in. The city's infrastructure, once a marvel of modern engineering, was now nothing more than a pile of rubble. The streets were littered with debris, and the once-thriving downtown area was now a desolate wasteland.

But it wasn't just the physical landscape that had changed. The very fabric of time itself seemed to have been altered. The city's residents, it seemed, had been transported back in time to the year 1491.

"I was walking to work when suddenly, I was in the middle of a forest," said John Smith, a local businessman. "I saw people in period clothing, and I realized that I had been transported back in time. I couldn't believe it."

As the city's residents struggled to come to terms with their new reality, archaeologists and historians were left to ponder the implications of the event. "This is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to study a city in its prime," said Dr. Jane Thompson, a leading expert in urban archaeology. "We will be able to learn so much about the city's history, its people, and its culture."

But as the days passed, it became clear that the city's disappearance was not just a historical anomaly. It was a mystery that would take years, if not centuries, to unravel.

**THE MYSTERY DEEPENS**

As the city's residents struggled to adapt to their new reality, strange occurrences began to plague the area. Tools and technology from the 21st century were found in the forest, alongside ancient artifacts and relics. It was as if the city's disappearance had created a rift in the space-time continuum, allowing for the exchange of goods and ideas between two vastly different eras.

"I was out collecting firewood when I stumbled upon a strange object," said Sarah Johnson, a local resident. "It was a smartphone, but it was covered in dust and looked like it had been there for centuries. I had no idea what it was or what it was for."

As the city's residents continued to adapt to their new reality, they began to realize that they were not alone. There were others, people who had also been transported back in time, and they were all trying to make sense of what had happened.

**THE SEARCH FOR ANSWERS**

The search for answers continues, as scientists and historians work to unravel the mystery of the city's disappearance. But as the days turn into weeks, and the weeks turn into months, it becomes clear that the truth may be more complex, and more mysterious, than anyone could have imagined.

**THE INTERROBANG**

?! What happened to the city of Akron?! Will we ever find out?!
